authority.source_of_truth: Versioned compiler source, schemas, frozen experiment requests, attempt records, and finalized evidence packages.
authority.task_authority: Reviewed GitHub issues and immutable experiment request identities.
authority.acceptance_authority: Compiler verification, independently executed checks, exact artifact identities, and explicit finalization decisions.
authority.deployment_authority: No production deployment authority; downstream repositories and protected workflows own publication or runtime promotion.

data.retention: Requests, attempts, failures, receipts, manifests, and finalized packages remain content-addressed and historically traceable.
data.deletion: Invalid or restricted payloads are excluded from active packages and superseded by retained correction or revocation evidence.
data.secret_storage: Execution and publication credentials remain in protected environments outside compiled packages.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Finalized packages are superseded or revoked by new signed evidence; historical attempts are not rewritten.

stabilization.summary: Decompose large lifecycle workflows into independently tested reusable workflows and composite actions.
Add repository-task, sealed-evaluator, semantic-trajectory, and governed-corpus package profiles.
Verify finalized packages from clean exact-source builds and attach provenance attestations.
